# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless, freckled face. He is described as broad-faced and perpetually smiling.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Billy is stolid, good-natured, and extremely shy, possessing a painful lack of conversational skills. He speaks very little in social situations and often simply grins, chuckles, or watches others. Despite his shyness, he is a great worker with no bad habits.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

- Shy  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

Billy grew up in Avonlea as part of the Andrews family. As a young man, he admired Anne Shirley immensely and drove her, along with Diana Barry and Jane Andrews, to a concert at the White Sands Hotel, though he decamped before supper out of shyness. He attended local gatherings and spent evenings quietly watching Anne. When his father gave him the upper farm in his own name, he wished to marry Anne but was too shy to propose himself, so he sent his sister Jane to ask her on his behalf. After Anne rejected the proposal, he married Nettie Blewett instead, and they 'appeared out' at the Avonlea church together.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
